name: Zoltara's Carnival of the Cursed
source:
Isaac threw away his one shot at an Astronomy scholarship just for defending himself. Now, cynical and disillusioned, he strolls down the street of his apartment. But what Isacc doesn't know, is that this night may just change his entire life forever.. 

[From [url=https://vermillion-rex.itch.io/zoltaras-carnival-of-the-cursed]itch.io[/url]]
